Starting with quarter 2 '27 highlights, we delivered another strong quarter with revenue from 
operations growing by 14% to INR3,399 crores. Our same-store sales growth stood at 5.4%. The 
festivals this year have shifted from quarter 2 to quarter 3. This has had an impact of 3% to 4%

start to the festivals. The festival season is now panning out in Q3, and this has reinforced our 
confidence in the demand momentum as we approach Diwali and the wedding season for this 
year.  
Operating EBITDA for Q2 '27 was INR262 crores, which was a growth of 3.7% over last year 
and a margin of 7.7% versus 8.5% in last year. Operating EBITDA growth was achieved despite 
low fixed cost absorption during the quarter due to the shift in festive buying to quarter 3 of '27.

Profit after tax, adjusted for ESOP charges, was INR172 crores, which is a 6.4% growth over 
last year and PAT margin of 5.1% versus 5.4% last year, impacted again by operating deleverage 
due to the shift in festivals. Our performance was supported by the strength of our own brand 
offerings, our customer-first approach, and very disciplined execution.  
On the macro front, demand conditions remained steady, despite renewed inflationary pressure 
across key raw material categories and a somewhat uneven monsoon. Our differentiated 
merchandise, compelling price positioning, and deep understanding of customer needs continues 
to resonate with our shoppers, reinforcing the resilience of our business.  
I will quickly shift gears to first-half results and highlights for this year. Revenue from operations 
grew by 16.4% to INR7,126 crores. Same-store sales growth stood at 7.7%. The shift in festival 
has had an impact of 1.5% to 2% on same-store sales growth. Adjusting for that, same-store 
sales growth for the first half will be about 9.5%.  
 
Operating EBITDA for the first half was INR649 crores, which is a growth of 12.5% over last 
year and a margin of 9.1% versus 9.4% for last year. Again, the margin was impacted by 
operating deleverage arising from the shift in festive buying from first half to second half of the 
year.  
 
Profit after tax, adjusted for ESOP charges, grew by 15.8% to INR437 crores, a margin of 6.1% 
versus 6.4% (This was incorrectly said. Please read 6.4% as 6.2%) for last year. This again was 
impacted by operating deleverage arising from the shift in festivals.  
 
We continue to advance our store expansion strategy, adding 26 gross new stores during the 
quarter, and 53 new stores during the first half of the year. This takes the total store count to 844 
as of September '26 end. And we now have presence in 582 cities across the country.  
 
In quarter 2, we launched the first pilot store of Belong & Co., our new apparel format, catering 
to young, affluent urban consumers with a very distinct brand proposition, offering effortless 
fashion. Our trading area stood at 1.41 crores square feet. Our private brands contributed 74% 
to revenue in first half of '27. Our quick commerce expanded to 781 stores across 532 cities in 
the country, and registered users on quick commerce crossed 1.5 crores people across the 
country.  
 
Looking ahead, we remain focused on capturing growth opportunities while staying very agile 
in an evolving geopolitical and inflationary environment by strengthening our merchandise 
offering, enhancing supply chain efficiency, and maintaining disciplined cost management. We 
aim to continue delivering compelling customer value and sustainable and profitable growth.
